scope: P0 partial: fixed EGO upstream source, audited migration, and Jazzy build only; runtime and full system source lock are not qualified.

reconstruction.method: git archive at exact upstream revision, then apply the three patches in manifest order

legacy_ego_changes: CMakeLists.txt and package.xml add std_msgs for control_hold
ego_replan_fsm subscribes to transient-local control_hold, pauses replanning/collision checks, and replans on resume
legacy_migration_audit.legacy_ego_package_license: TODO in package.xml; no package LICENSE file found
legacy_migration_audit.old_quadrotor_msgs_package_license: MIT in package.xml; no package LICENSE file found; package not imported
legacy_migration_audit.migration_decision: Do not import the dirty legacy EGO fork or quadrotor_msgs. Use the fixed ZJU ROS 2 upstream planner and own uav_interfaces/PositionCommand. Preserve hold/resume behavior as a separate own integration task before autonomous execution.

interface_and_boundary.depth_input: grid_map/depth (sensor_msgs/Image; synchronized with pose or odometry according to grid_map/pose_type)
interface_and_boundary.goal_input: geometry_msgs/PoseStamped configured by upstream FSM target type
interface_and_boundary.coordinate_defaults: grid_map/frame_id and PositionCommand.header.frame_id default to world; final ENU/world mapping and one-source parameterization are not implemented.
interface_and_boundary.control_boundary: EGO emits a trajectory message only. It does not publish PX4 setpoints or OffboardControlMode; uav_px4_bridge remains the only authorized PX4 control publisher.

first_attempt.reason: upstream cv_bridge/cv_bridge.h does not exist in the Jazzy container

limits: No planner behavior, obstacle avoidance, path safety, time-reset handling, or PX4 integration has been tested.
Full dependency lock, container image rebuild, and PX4/px4_msgs/agent runtime interoperability remain pending.
